dogecoin.text: When I had Covid I panic sold 75% of my $doge for a financial cushion, I regret it so much. Even in the dips it is still constantly and slowly growing over time, investing is taking money out of the hands of the impatient and putting it in the hands of the patient.

Do not panic sell your $DOGE. That is literally what they want to happen. Buys the dips, as long as people are purchasing it will hold value. Of course it’s going to fall, but If I never panic sold my DOGE in the first place I’d have tens of thousands more. Never again 😩
